up: Return the exact activity values and canonical SMILES for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1614213. Include the activity standard value, standard relation, standard units, standard type, the compound ChEMBL ID, the molecule pref_name, and the canonical SMILES.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  a.standard_value AS standard_value,
  a.standard_relation AS standard_relation,
  a.standard_units AS standard_units,
  a.standard_type AS standard_type,
  md.chembl_id AS chembl_id,
  md.pref_name AS pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE a.assay_id = (SELECT assay_id FROM assays WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614213')
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
